kind: Passenger flow regression derived from supplied game log and reproduced against pre-fix source

observations.interpretation: At the screenshot the generic assistance action corresponds to a pending boarding; the log does not show a new alighting request from person 1396. Repeated crowd-yield movement interferes with ordinary alighting paths.

regressions.before: failed: alighting passenger pulled two metres away from the path
failed: waiting chair moved interior passengers before assistance
failed: waiting boarding retained the controller despite an alighting request

behavior: Alighting and boarding walkers retain their own path and are not displaced by accessibility crowd yielding.
Interior yielding starts with a nearby assisted or physically ready native service.
A yielding rider reserves their new standing place and releases the previous place.
Yield control ends when the target is reached or the passenger changes task.
Alighting can defer unstarted boarding without removing either passenger or changing mobility.
The assistance panel distinguishes Prepare boarding from Prepare alighting in all supported languages.
Pending wheelchair calls use one normal bell press while preserving the persistent HUD warning.
